# Vendored dependencies

`push-receiver/` is a source snapshot of `MrMakaroni/push-receiver-rustiq`
commit `76b0e81302d9194f97f4f06acb454ef6d4d29e96`.

The snapshot keeps Rust+ installation reproducible and includes the hardened
MCS parser, abort-aware requests, and deterministic reconnect cleanup. Runtime
dependencies remain declared in the root `package.json` and lockfile.
